situations.source: Lumentum’s CEO Says “the Laws of Physics Are Working in Favor of Fiber.” Marvell Holders Are Buying It Cheap
situations.title: Marvell-Lumentum merger pending regulatory approval
situations.summary: Marvell's all-stock acquisition of Lumentum, valued at ~$115B, is not yet closed. The deal needs regulatory approvals, including China's, and is expected to close in H1 2028. If blocked, Marvell owes Lumentum a $3.2B fee. Lumentum trades at a 16% discount to the deal value, reflecting uncertainty.

outcomes.label: Marvell stock moves significantly before close
